name: LinkedIn Feed Creative Engine V5 - STAGING

parameters.jsCode:
const j=$json;
const peopleRule=j.People_Mode==='none'
  ? 'No people anywhere in the image.'
  : j.People_Mode==='one'
    ? 'Exactly one adult person maximum, natural anatomy, medium shot or wider, hands not prominent, no direct camera pose.'
    : 'Maximum two adult people, natural anatomy, candid side-angle composition, no hand close-up and no direct camera pose.';

const prompt=[
  'Photorealistic editorial business photograph for a LinkedIn feed. This is a photograph, NOT a poster, NOT an infographic, NOT graphic design.',
  j.Visual_Scene,
  'Visual mood: '+j.Visual_Mood+'.',
  'Palette direction: '+j.Palette_Direction+'.',
  peopleRule,
  'Single scene only. One clear visual idea only. No collage, no split panels, no before-and-after panels, no multiple scenes.',
  'The business idea must be understandable in one second from the physical scene itself.',
  'Egyptian or Middle Eastern SME context where appropriate, but use no national symbols and no branded uniforms.',
  'Natural daylight, realistic materials, credible small-business environment, editorial photography, restrained commercial polish.',
  'Place the main subject or object in the lower two thirds. The upper third should be visually calm because a separate headline layer will cover it later.',
  'ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT OR TEXT-LIKE MARKS: no words, letters, numbers, Arabic-like glyphs, pseudo-writing, logos, labels, signage, packaging print, watermarks, signatures or symbols.',
  'No screens, phones, laptops, whiteboards, dashboards, forms, documents, newspapers, menus, receipts, price tags, charts, maps, posters or UI.',
  'Use plain unbranded objects and blank surfaces only.',
  'Avoid objects that normally carry writing. For object-only scenes prefer smooth glass, matte wood, solid-color plastic and plain metal. Avoid cardboard cartons, shipping boxes, paper packaging and printed product surfaces.',
  'No surreal anatomy, no extra fingers, no duplicated limbs, no duplicated faces, no distorted bodies.',
  'Portrait 4:5 composition, high-resolution editorial realism.'
].join(' ');
return [{json:{...j,Image_Prompt_Final:prompt}}];

parameters.name: =STAGING LinkedIn V4 Row {{ $('Pick Next Future Image Job').first().json.row_number }} - {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss') }}

parameters.url: =https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{{ $('Upload Base Image to Drive').first().json.id }}/permissions/{{ $('Grant Temporary Image Access').first().json.id }}
